decisions.reason: The award gives an early positive signal and a yogurt variant costs little to keep listed, so the option is worth keeping open while demand resolves.
As the firm's featured flagship, launched only recently, its prospects are still uncertain and promising, which justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
A basic semi-hard cheese wheel fits the core range and costs little to maintain, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
This is a niche flavored variant in a broad cheese range with only a bare mention so far, so it is a candidate for pruning, but one year is too short to resolve its uncertainty.
It was launched as part of a deliberate new soft cheese line, and keeping it open is cheap while retail acceptance is still being learned.
A washed-rind soft cheese has narrower appeal and gets little visibility, but at low holding cost the option is kept for another period before a decision.
